portraits.name: Larry McMurtry
portraits.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset: editorial portrait for a refined vintage typewriter selection gallery.
Reference image: original photograph of Larry McMurtry, the only identity reference. Transform this specific young man's likeness into a meticulous banknote intaglio engraved portrait. Preserve his recognizable face, dark swept hair, glasses, age and left-facing three-quarter profile; retain the open collared shirt. Reframe as a centered head-and-shoulders bust, face occupying most of the image, full hair and chin visible with modest clear margin. Remove bookshelves, bottle, hands and surroundings.
Style: authentic hand-cut copperplate line engraving used for banknote portraits, dense fine curved parallel contour lines and delicate crosshatching; facial planes and hair modeled entirely with crisp ink lines, restrained contrast, no photorealistic shading. Single dark warm olive-charcoal ink #343b30 on clean warm ivory #f3eddf. Crisp enough to remain recognizable as a small 76px portrait. Vertical 4:5 composition. Light unprinted background, subtle line taper at lower shoulders, no decorative border, no text, no numbers, no currency symbols, no seal, no watermark. This is a portrait illustration, not a whole banknote.
